Type: rectangular dark wood dining table
Use: dining, hosting dinners; dining room, kitchen
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: wood veneer with a dark brown stain, solid wood legs
Colors: dark brown
Shape: long rectangular top with a thin edge, four angled legs splayed at the ends and joined to the top with a soft curve, slim frame, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, refined, calm, grounded
Goes with: light or black chairs, white walls, brass or linen accents; modern Scandinavian or contemporary dining rooms
